headline: Report: $250K fines for Sirianni, Vrabel, Glenn temporarily on hold
summary: Nick Sirianni was fined $250,000 for conduct toward officials, a source said, confirming an SI report that noted Mike Vrabel and Aaron Glenn were similarly fined.

headline: Roger Goodell: NFL Welcomes Investigation Into Jalen Hurts Treatment
summary: The Eagles’ handling of Jalen Hurts’ blood clots has drawn scrutiny from the NFLPA, who called for an investigation into the situation despite approval from the league. headline: Davante Adams will have a "cleanup" procedure on his hamstring
summary: Rams wide receiver Davante Adams was placed on injured reserve this week and his path back to the field will include a visit to the operating room.

headline: Texans' Tank Dell says he won't fear being hit in return Sunday against Giants
summary: Texans WR Tank Dell said he is "ready to get tackled" on Sunday when he returns for his first game since suffering a gruesome knee injury in December 2024.
